result.brief: 提出语义角色化的任务条件世界模型 SR-WM，用视觉实体编码器与角色绑定器构建统一角色状态，支撑动作生成与重排序，将物体中心预测转化为连接视觉动力学与规划决策的语义接口。
result.reason: Task-conditioned world model with visual entity encoder and role-based latent state for planning; main contribution is robot planning/control, so primary is applications, with representation learning as enabling.
